0022600221.text: The Grizzlies host the Nuggets at 6-3 overall, with a 2-3 home record, a 4-0 road record, and a three-game losing streak after going 6-3 over their last ten, leaving Memphis third in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and seventh in the West. Denver is 5-3 through eight games with a two-game winning streak, sitting fourth in the Northwest, 2 games back, and ninth in the West, while Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain). The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season series, and in the 2025-26 season the Grizzlies lost 1-3, including a 136-119 loss in Denver on April 8, 2026, the most recent meeting.
